notes.en: AI connections now open as pages and show remaining usage and request counts for each. Gurum asks before adding schedules, events or reminders, and topic chats are simpler with the same composer as the Gurum room. Cards use Gurum green, links open in your default browser, and browser sign-in is more accurate.
